ic_device.name: TL431
ic_device.description: Three-terminal adjustable shunt regulator with specified thermal stability; output voltage settable from Vref (~2.5V) to 36V with two external resistors; typical output impedance 0.2 ohm; sink-current capability 1mA to 100mA.

functional_blocks.name: Internal Reference and Amplifier
